description: This file defines a configured API client using Axios for a React frontend. It includes setup for base URL and headers, request interceptors to add auth tokens, and response interceptors to handle errors like token expiration, with redirect to login.

methods.name: axios.create
methods.description: Creates an Axios instance with custom configuration for base URL and headers.

methods.name: apiClient.interceptors.request.use
methods.description: Adds a request interceptor to include the Authorization header with a token if available.

methods.name: apiClient.interceptors.response.use
methods.description: Adds a response interceptor to handle authentication errors such as 401, clearing tokens and redirecting to login.
